Title: LSJ - Playing a Concealed Weapon without actually having one

Messages.Author: Magnus
Messages.Body:
I´ve found that a good way to discard Concealed Weapons is playing
them without actually having a gun/melee weapon in your hand. Today
some of my associates claimed that I actually need to play a weapon
after using CW, i.e. that I need to have both in my hand to use CW.
Correct ?

Magnus

Correct.
Card text: "Equip this minion with a non-unique weapon card from your hand"

Ruling:
Playing Cards
* If a card targets (chooses, selects, is played on, etc.) another card,
then the card can only be played if an appropriate target is available.

Suppose you have a Disguised Weapon and a .44 Magnum in hand while an
Infernal Pursuit is in play. Do you play the Disguised Weapon and the
.44 simultaneously, or do you play the Disguised Weapon, draw two
cards (one if which is an Ivory Bow), and have an opportunity to play
a _different_ weapon than that which was in your initial hand?

Jeff

Messages.Author: DJ.Mik
Messages.Body:
jeff...@hotmail.com (Jeff Kuta) wrote in message

> Suppose you have a Disguised Weapon and a .44 Magnum in hand while an
> Infernal Pursuit is in play. Do you play the Disguised Weapon and the
> .44 simultaneously, or do you play the Disguised Weapon, draw two
> cards (one if which is an Ivory Bow), and have an opportunity to play
> a _different_ weapon than that which was in your initial hand?
>
> Jeff

Well, since you're allowed to replace the disguised weapon you can
play the I.B. if you draw it. You just have to be able to actually
equip with a weapon, it doesn't have to be one that's in your hand
already...

Dj Mik

[LSJ 19991207] suggests otherwise.

"The weapon to be equipped must be named/selected when the card is
played, and it must be in your hand when you play Disguised Weapon."

I can't find a reversal of this.
